title: Wilson's disease inheritance, Menkes comparison and copper transport
guide: Autosomal recessive ATP7B on chromosome 13q, Menkes ATP7A on X chromosome (3 months, seizures, brittle hair), daily intake 2-5 mg with 1 mg absorption via DMT1, metallothionein 3-year capacity, fundamental defect in ceruloplasmin incorporation and biliary excretion, apoceruloplasmin false elevation, and acute adolescent clues (low Hb, low cholinesterase, mild transaminitis, low ALP).

title: Wilson's presentations, jaundice types, tennis-racquet cristae and Neuro-Wilson's
guide: Coombs-negative hemolytic anemia with low ALP (copper-zinc competition), chronic asymptomatic transaminitis (<150 U/L), mixed cirrhosis on ultrasound, maximum jaundice tendency across pre-hepatic, hepatic, and post-hepatic forms, tennis-racquet mitochondrial cristae on EM, glycogenated nuclei, zone 1 periportal predilection, and 10-year latency to Neuro-Wilson's.

title: Neurological features, Kayser-Fleischer ring, sunflower cataract and systemic pathology
guide: Dysarthria (m/c), Parkinsonism, Risus sardonicus, wing-beating tremors, Kayser-Fleischer rings in Descemet's membrane (60-65% hepatic, 95-99% neuro, seen in PBC/PSC, regresses with chelation), sunflower cataract, hypoparathyroidism, proximal RTA Type 2, and recurrent spontaneous abortion.

title: Diagnostic ceruloplasmin algorithm, biopsy cut-off, Nazar index and chelation
guide: Ceruloplasmin cut-offs (>20 rule out, 10-20 intermediate with free copper spill, <10 confirmatory), liver biopsy >250 µg/g dry weight by neutron activation/atomic absorption, false elevation causes, Nazar prognostic index (bilirubin, AST, PT), D-penicillamine (250 mg to 1.5 g empty stomach, lupus/myasthenia/pyridoxine 25 mg risks), trientine, tetrathiomolybdate, and zinc (50 mg TDS).

title: Brain MRI signs in Wilson's and Hereditary Hemochromatosis genetics
guide: Face of giant panda, basal ganglia and thalamic hyperintensity, bisected and Mercedes-Benz trisected pontine signs, Bright Claustrum sign, Hereditary Hemochromatosis autosomal recessive HFE gene on 6p (4th-5th decade), homozygous C282Y vs heterozygous PCT/NASH, juvenile non-HFE genes (HJV, TfR2, hepcidin), and alcohol acceleration.

title: Iron transport pathophysiology, screening saturation and liver MRI
guide: Apical DMT-1 entry, basolateral ferroportin export, hepatic hepcidin negative regulation, HFE mutation failure, transferrin saturation > 45% as best screening test (S.Fe/TIBC x 100), low TIBC, Prussian blue periportal hemosiderosis, and liver MRI low intensity with splenic sparing.

title: Systemic manifestations, genetic IOC, phlebotomy and irreversible damage
guide: Type 3c bronze DM, DCM > RCMP, CPPD arthropathy with hook-like osteophytes in 2nd/3rd MCP and wrists, pituitary stalk hypogonadotropic hypogonadism triad, slate-grey bronzing, HFE C282Y mutation IOC, weekly phlebotomy (target ferritin <50-500 ng/mL), subcutaneous desferrioxamine, irreversible joint and gonadal damage, and persistent post-transplant HCC risk.
